main_reasons: Severe financial stress: $22.9M net loss, exit of SBA 7(a) business, 52% staff cut, dividends (incl. cumulative preferred) suspended, PIK amendment on sub notes and deferred holdco term-loan interest, only $769K holdco cash
Strong incentive to understate losses: bank total risk-based capital 10.18% vs 10.00% well-capitalized threshold, and $195.5M brokered deposits depend on well-capitalized status

ACL judgment under pressure: C&I net charge-offs 6.5% of average loans, nonperforming and substandard loans rising, yet Q4 provision ($2.0M) below Q4 net charge-offs ($4.6M) and ACL fell from $24.5M to $22.0M in Q4
Management says it 'strengthened' problem-loan identification and risk-rating processes in 2025, suggesting earlier ratings were not timely, yet reports ICFR effective with no changes in ICFR
$6.5M net deferred tax asset carried with no valuation allowance despite a likely three-year cumulative pre-tax loss (2024 profit was helped by an $11.6M sale-leaseback gain)
Zero loan modifications to borrowers in financial difficulty is reported for both years, which looks implausible for a distressed SBA/C&I book
Disclosure errors: 2024 deposits shown as $985M vs $1,143M, an $11.1M 'call of HTM securities' though HTM stayed at $2.5M (likely AFS mislabel), a wrong cross-reference

Mitigants: losses are recognized openly and large, plain community-bank accounting, Level 3 assets are modest (about $54M FVO loans and $12.6M MSRs), long-tenured national auditor (Forvis Mazars), and no restatement, regulatory order or litigation is disclosed
